measurements.how_measured: divided frame into quarters and estimated bounding box of green car versus frame
measurements.statement: foreground green car is cropped by the left edge and dominates the frame in low three-quarter front view
measurements.value: spans left edge to ~75% width, ~1/4 to ~4/5 height, ~60% frame area

measurements.how_measured: traced skyline, building roofline and ground line against vertical thirds
measurements.statement: frame is horizontally banded with sky on top, cars plus building in middle, pavers below
measurements.value: sky top ~40%, ground bottom ~30%, building occupies right third mid-band

measurements.how_measured: counted distinct front grilles, headlights and plates and compared bumper positions along depth axis
measurements.statement: exactly three cars recede diagonally from front-left to back-right with decreasing apparent size
measurements.value: 3 cars, front bumper overlaps middle car, diagonal recession to right edge

measurements.how_measured: compared area of green and blue paint versus gray sky, pavers and dark building and glass
measurements.statement: most of frame is desaturated grays with only two saturated car colors
measurements.value: neutrals ~75-80% frame, emerald green ~25% and medium blue ~12%, black third car <8%

measurements.how_measured: observed cloud cover, absence of hard cast shadows under cars, and elongated highlights on hood and fender
measurements.statement: light is soft overcast daylight with no hard shadows and broad glossy reflections on paint
measurements.value: diffused daylight, shadowless, strong hood speculars

measurements.how_measured: compared header versus code cap-height on front plate and noted weight, form, spacing and color contrast
measurements.statement: license plate type uses tiny upper line and large lower code in low-contrast sans with uniform stroke
measurements.value: header height : code height ~1:4, medium-bold sans with even stroke, wide letterspacing, dark blue on white with small color emblem

hypotheses.statement: Low close three-quarter view plus left-edge cropping makes the green car hierarchically dominant, with size and sharpness stepping down to blue then black to create depth
Muted gray sky, pavers and building form a quiet field that lets the two saturated paints carry emphasis, so the eye lands on green then slides to blue
Soft shadowless light and orderly diagonal recession give a calm premium showroom-like mood despite an outdoor lot

relations.rule: Keep primary subject at least ~2x apparent size of next subject, cropped by frame edge and viewed from below its midline to enforce dominance
Limit saturated hues to two covering <40% of frame, holding remaining 60-80% to desaturated neutrals
Place repeating subjects along a single diagonal depth line with decreasing scale and overlapping edges to create stepping rhythm

fragile_if_changed: Raising the camera to eye level in bright direct sun would destroy the low heroic dominance and quiet neutral field that lets the glossy green paint dominate.

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'environment bands and palette field'
